title: LOCK IN local normalized sensor sample
description: Adapter output, not a claim about native SDK payload names. Raw samples stay local after consent. Native quality semantics must be verified against the installed SDK; a schema-valid object is not automatically usable.

receivedMonotonicMs.description: Application monotonic receive-time; never replace with a provider wall-clock timestamp.

measuredMonotonicMs.description: Measurement time mapped to the same monotonic clock only when its original clock semantics are established; otherwise null.

pulseBpm.description: May retain an out-of-supported-range value locally for rejection diagnostics; the acceptance function rejects it. No fabrication, clamping, diagnosis, or public-event upload.

nativeConfidence.description: Preserved native scalar, without invented cross-provider confidence normalization.

validationCode.description: Native validation/status scalar. The installed adapter determines which documented codes qualify as accepted.
